improved-gouge.name: Improved Gouge
improved-gouge.r1: Increases the duration of your Gouge ability by 0.5 sec.
improved-gouge.rmax: Increases the duration of your Gouge ability by 1.5 sec.

remorseless-attacks.name: Remorseless Attacks
remorseless-attacks.r1: After killing a non-trivial enemy, gives you a 20% increased critical strike chance on your next Sinister Strike, Backstab, Ambush, Mutilate, or Ghostly Strike. Lasts 20 sec.
remorseless-attacks.rmax: After killing a non-trivial enemy, gives you a 40% increased critical strike chance on your next Sinister Strike, Backstab, Ambush, Mutilate, or Ghostly Strike. Lasts 20 sec.

malice.name: Malice
malice.r1: Increases your critical strike chance with all attacks and Poisons by 1%.
malice.rmax: Increases your critical strike chance with all attacks and Poisons by 5%.

ruthlessness.name: Ruthlessness
ruthlessness.r1: Gives your finishing moves a 20% chance to add a Combo Point to your target.
ruthlessness.rmax: Gives your finishing moves a 60% chance to add a Combo Point to your target.

murder.name: Murder
murder.r1: Increases all damage dealt by 2% against Humanoid and Giant targets.
murder.rmax: Increases all damage dealt by 4% against Humanoid and Giant targets.

improved-slice-and-dice.name: Improved Slice and Dice
improved-slice-and-dice.r1: Increases the duration of your Slice and Dice ability by 15%.
improved-slice-and-dice.rmax: Increases the duration of your Slice and Dice ability by 45%.

relentless-strikes.name: Relentless Strikes
relentless-strikes.r1: Your finishing moves have a 20% chance per Combo Point to restore 25 Energy.
relentless-strikes.rmax: Your finishing moves have a 20% chance per Combo Point to restore 25 Energy.

improved-expose-armor.name: Improved Expose Armor
improved-expose-armor.r1: Reduces the Energy cost of your Expose Armor ability by 5, and refunds 1 Combo Point when cast with 5 Combo Points.
improved-expose-armor.rmax: Reduces the Energy cost of your Expose Armor ability by 10, and refunds 2 Combo Points when cast with 5 Combo Points.

lethality.name: Lethality
lethality.r1: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Sinister Strike, Gouge, Backstab, Mutilate, Ghostly Strike, and Hemorrhage abilities by 4%.
lethality.rmax: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Sinister Strike, Gouge, Backstab, Mutilate, Ghostly Strike, and Hemorrhage abilities by 20%.

vile-poisons.name: Vile Poisons
vile-poisons.r1: Increases the damage dealt by your poisons by 4% and gives your poisons an additional 8% chance to resist dispel effects.
vile-poisons.rmax: Increases the damage dealt by your poisons by 20% and gives your poisons an additional 40% chance to resist dispel effects.

cold-blood.name: Cold Blood
cold-blood.r1: When activated, increases the critical strike chance of your next Sinister Strike, Backstab, Ambush, Eviscerate, or Mutilate by 100%.
cold-blood.rmax: When activated, increases the critical strike chance of your next Sinister Strike, Backstab, Ambush, Eviscerate, or Mutilate by 100%.

improved-poisons.name: Improved Poisons
improved-poisons.r1: Increases the chance to apply Poisons to your target by 2%, and gives Poison applications a 10% chance to not consume a charge.
improved-poisons.rmax: Increases the chance to apply Poisons to your target by 10%, and gives Poison applications a 50% chance to not consume a charge.

mutilate.name: Mutilate
mutilate.r1: Instantly attacks with both weapons for 75% weapon damage plus an additional 17.25 with each weapon. Damage increased by 20% against Poisoned targets. Awards 2 Combo Points.
mutilate.rmax: Instantly attacks with both weapons for 75% weapon damage plus an additional 17.25 with each weapon. Damage increased by 20% against Poisoned targets. Awards 2 Combo Points.

improved-kidney-shot.name: Improved Kidney Shot
improved-kidney-shot.r1: Enemies Stunned by your Kidney Shot ability take 5% increased damage from your poisons and attacks.
improved-kidney-shot.rmax: Enemies Stunned by your Kidney Shot ability take 10% increased damage from your poisons and attacks.

seal-fate.name: Seal Fate
seal-fate.r1: Your critical strikes from abilities that add Combo Points have a 20% chance to add an additional Combo Point.
seal-fate.rmax: Your critical strikes from abilities that add Combo Points have a 100% chance to add an additional Combo Point.

venom.name: Venom
venom.r1: Finishing move that increases the damage of your Poisons by 30% and your chance to apply Poisons by 10%. Lasts longer per combo point: 1 point : 9 sec 2 points: 12 sec 3 points: 15 sec 4 points: 18 sec 5 points: 21 sec
venom.rmax: Finishing move that increases the damage of your Poisons by 30% and your chance to apply Poisons by 10%. Lasts longer per combo point: 1 point : 9 sec 2 points: 12 sec 3 points: 15 sec 4 points: 18 sec 5 points: 21 sec

improved-eviscerate.name: Improved Eviscerate
improved-eviscerate.r1: Increases the damage done by your Eviscerate ability by 7%.
improved-eviscerate.rmax: Increases the damage done by your Eviscerate ability by 20%.

improved-sinister-strike.name: Improved Sinister Strike
improved-sinister-strike.r1: Reduces the Energy cost of your Sinister Strike ability by 3.
improved-sinister-strike.rmax: Reduces the Energy cost of your Sinister Strike ability by 5.

puncturing-wounds.name: Puncturing Wounds
puncturing-wounds.r1: Increases the critical strike chance of your Backstab by 10% and your Mutilate by 5%, and gives Backstab a 15% chance to add an additional Combo Point.
puncturing-wounds.rmax: Increases the critical strike chance of your Backstab by 30% and your Mutilate by 15%, and gives Backstab a 45% chance to add an additional Combo Point.

precision.name: Precision
precision.r1: Improves your chance to hit by 1%.
precision.rmax: Improves your chance to hit by 3%.

endurance.name: Endurance
endurance.r1: Reduces the cooldown of your Sprint and Evasion abilities by 30%.
endurance.rmax: Reduces the cooldown of your Sprint and Evasion abilities by 60%.

riposte.name: Riposte
riposte.cost: 10 Energy · Melee Range · Instant · 6 sec cooldown
riposte.r1: A strike that becomes active after parrying an opponent's attack. This attack deals 150% weapon damage and disarms the target for 6 sec.
riposte.rmax: A strike that becomes active after parrying an opponent's attack. This attack deals 150% weapon damage and disarms the target for 6 sec.

improved-sprint.name: Improved Sprint
improved-sprint.r1: Gives a 50% chance to remove all movement impairing effects when you activate your Sprint ability.
improved-sprint.rmax: Gives a 100% chance to remove all movement impairing effects when you activate your Sprint ability.

improved-kick.name: Improved Kick
improved-kick.r1: Gives your Kick ability a 50% chance to Silence the target for 2 sec.
improved-kick.rmax: Gives your Kick ability a 100% chance to Silence the target for 2 sec.

flawless-execution.name: Flawless Execution
flawless-execution.r1: Reduces the Energy cost of your Eviscerate ability by 10.
flawless-execution.rmax: Reduces the Energy cost of your Eviscerate ability by 10.

dual-wield-specialization.name: Dual Wield Specialization
dual-wield-specialization.r1: Increases the damage done by your off-hand weapon by 5%.
dual-wield-specialization.rmax: Increases the damage done by your off-hand weapon by 25%.

blade-flurry.name: Blade Flurry
blade-flurry.r1: Increases your melee attack speed by 20% and your melee attacks strike an additional nearby opponent. Lasts 15 sec.
blade-flurry.rmax: Increases your melee attack speed by 20% and your melee attacks strike an additional nearby opponent. Lasts 15 sec.

hack-and-slash.name: Hack and Slash
hack-and-slash.r1: Gives your melee weapon attacks a benefit depending on the weapon. Axe/Sword: Your successful melee attacks have a 1% chance to trigger an extra attack on the target. Dagger/Fist: Increases your critical strike chance by 1%. Mace: Your attacks ignore 3% of your target's armor.
hack-and-slash.rmax: Gives your melee weapon attacks a benefit depending on the weapon. Axe/Sword: Your successful melee attacks have a 5% chance to trigger an extra attack on the target. Dagger/Fist: Increases your critical strike chance by 5%. Mace: Your attacks ignore 15% of your target's armor.

weapon-expertise.name: Weapon Expertise
weapon-expertise.r1: Reduces the chance for your attacks to be Dodged or Parried by 1%.
weapon-expertise.rmax: Reduces the chance for your attacks to be Dodged or Parried by 2%.

aggression.name: Aggression
aggression.r1: Increases the damage of your Sinister Strike, Backstab, and Eviscerate abilities by 2%.
aggression.rmax: Increases the damage of your Sinister Strike, Backstab, and Eviscerate abilities by 6%.

adrenaline-rush.name: Adrenaline Rush
adrenaline-rush.r1: Increases your Energy regeneration rate by 100% for 15 sec.
adrenaline-rush.rmax: Increases your Energy regeneration rate by 100% for 15 sec.

camouflage.name: Camouflage
camouflage.r1: Reduces your speed penalty from your Stealth ability by 3% and reduces its cooldown by 2 sec.
camouflage.rmax: Reduces your speed penalty from your Stealth ability by 15% and reduces its cooldown by 6 sec.

master-of-deception.name: Master of Deception
master-of-deception.r1: Reduces the chance enemies have to detect you while in Stealth mode as if you were 1 level higher.
master-of-deception.rmax: Reduces the chance enemies have to detect you while in Stealth mode as if you were 3 levels higher.

opportunity.name: Opportunity
opportunity.r1: Increases the damage dealt by your Backstab, Garrote, Ambush, and Mutilate abilities by 5%.
opportunity.rmax: Increases the damage dealt by your Backstab, Garrote, Ambush, and Mutilate abilities by 10%.

setup.name: Setup
setup.r1: Gives you a 33% chance to add a Combo Point to your target after Dodging one of their attacks or fully resisting one of their spells.
setup.rmax: Gives you a 100% chance to add a Combo Point to your target after Dodging one of their attacks or fully resisting one of their spells.

elusiveness.name: Elusiveness
elusiveness.r1: Reduces the cooldown of your Vanish and Blind abilities by 45 sec.
elusiveness.rmax: Reduces the cooldown of your Vanish and Blind abilities by 90 sec.

dirty-tricks.name: Dirty Tricks
dirty-tricks.r1: Reduces the Energy cost of your Sap and Blind abilities by 25%.
dirty-tricks.rmax: Reduces the Energy cost of your Sap and Blind abilities by 50%.

improved-ambush.name: Improved Ambush
improved-ambush.r1: Increases the critical strike chance of your Ambush ability by 15%.
improved-ambush.rmax: Increases the critical strike chance of your Ambush ability by 45%.

initiative.name: Initiative
initiative.r1: Gives you a 33% chance to add an additional combo point to your target when using your Ambush, Garrote, or Cheap Shot ability.
initiative.rmax: Gives you a 100% chance to add an additional combo point to your target when using your Ambush, Garrote, or Cheap Shot ability.

ghostly-strike.name: Ghostly Strike
ghostly-strike.cost: 40 Energy · Melee Range · Instant · 20 sec cooldown
ghostly-strike.r1: A strike that deals 125% (180% if a Dagger is equipped in your Main Hand) weapon damage and increases your chance to dodge by 15% for 7 sec. Awards 1 combo point.
ghostly-strike.rmax: A strike that deals 125% (180% if a Dagger is equipped in your Main Hand) weapon damage and increases your chance to dodge by 15% for 7 sec. Awards 1 combo point.

improved-distract.name: Improved Distract
improved-distract.r1: Increases the radius of your Distract ability by 3 yds, and further reduces the Stealth detection of distracted enemies as though they were an additional 1 levels lower.
improved-distract.rmax: Increases the radius of your Distract ability by 5 yds, and further reduces the Stealth detection of distracted enemies as though they were an additional 2 levels lower.

heightened-senses.name: Heightened Senses
heightened-senses.r1: Increases your Stealth detection as if you were 1 level higher and reduces your chance to be hit by spells and ranged attacks by 2%.
heightened-senses.rmax: Increases your Stealth detection as if you were 3 levels higher and reduces your chance to be hit by spells and ranged attacks by 4%.

premeditation.name: Premeditation
premeditation.r1: Adds 2 Combo Points to your target. You must add to or use those combo points within 20 sec or the combo points are lost.
premeditation.rmax: Adds 2 Combo Points to your target. You must add to or use those combo points within 20 sec or the combo points are lost.

serrated-blades.name: Serrated Blades
serrated-blades.r1: Causes your attacks to ignore 3% of your target's Armor and increases the damage dealt by your Rupture ability by 10%.
serrated-blades.rmax: Causes your attacks to ignore 9% of your target's Armor and increases the damage dealt by your Rupture ability by 30%.

dirty-deeds.name: Dirty Deeds
dirty-deeds.r1: Reduces the Energy cost of your Cheap Shot and Garrote abilities by 10, and your Garrote ability no longer requires you to be behind your target.
dirty-deeds.rmax: Reduces the Energy cost of your Cheap Shot and Garrote abilities by 20, and your Garrote ability no longer requires you to be behind your target.

preparation.name: Preparation
preparation.r1: When activated, this ability immediately finishes the cooldown on your other Rogue abilities.
preparation.rmax: When activated, this ability immediately finishes the cooldown on your other Rogue abilities.

hemorrhage.name: Hemorrhage
hemorrhage.r1: An instant strike that deals 100% weapon damage (145% if a Dagger is equipped) and causes the target to take 15% increased Rupture damage from the Rogue. Lasts 15 sec. Awards 1 Combo Point.
hemorrhage.rmax: An instant strike that deals 100% weapon damage (145% if a Dagger is equipped) and causes the target to take 15% increased Rupture damage from the Rogue. Lasts 15 sec. Awards 1 Combo Point.

quietus.name: Quietus
quietus.r1: Your Sinister Strike, Ghostly Strike, and Hemorrhage abilities cause 2% more damage against targets below 35% health.
quietus.rmax: Your Sinister Strike, Ghostly Strike, and Hemorrhage abilities cause 10% more damage against targets below 35% health.

cutthroat.name: Cutthroat
cutthroat.r1: Your Backstab has a 3% chance to cause your next Ambush within 10 sec to not require Stealth.
cutthroat.rmax: Your Backstab has a 15% chance to cause your next Ambush within 10 sec to not require Stealth.

thousand-cuts.name: Thousand Cuts
thousand-cuts.r1: When your Rupture ability deals periodic damage, the Energy cost of your next Hemorrhage or Backstab ability within 10 sec is reduced by 3, stacking up to 5 times.
thousand-cuts.rmax: When your Rupture ability deals periodic damage, the Energy cost of your next Hemorrhage or Backstab ability within 10 sec is reduced by 3, stacking up to 5 times.
